01Residency routes

Three ways to live in Spain

Each route fits a different life. Here is the short version; we choose the right one with your real case.

01

Digital Nomad

For remote workers and freelancers whose employer or clients are outside Spain.

  • Income of 200% of the minimum wage: €2,442 to €2,849 a month
  • Up to 20% of your work may come from Spanish clients
  • A 3-year card, with a legal answer time of 20 working days
Income needed, from€2,442 a monthWork it out for my family
02

Non-lucrative

For families living on savings, rent or other passive income, without working in Spain.

  • €2,400 a month for the main applicant, plus €600 for each family member
  • No work in Spain in the first year; after that it can change to a work permit
  • One year first, then renewals of two and two years
Income needed, from€2,400 a monthWork it out for my family
03

Student

For anyone admitted to a recognised university or school in Spain.

  • Proof of €600 a month for living costs
  • Part-time work up to 30 hours a week
  • Spanish at B1 or B2, or IELTS 6.0 to 6.5
Funds needed€600 a monthWork it out for my family

03Documents

Your file, built with you

Each route asks for its own papers. These are the ones most files share; you get your exact list after the consultation.

Papers most files need

  • Valid passport
  • Criminal record certificate
  • Medical certificate
  • Health insurance
  • Proof of income or savings
  • Sworn translations and legalisation

We check each paper, arrange the translations and tell you what is missing before anything is filed.
